name: FlashLoopAdapter accepts a fake Safe and calls a caller-chosen router as a module
summary: Safes enabled FlashLoopAdapter as a module for Aave flash-loop positions. Its entry point accepted any caller whose isModuleEnabled(adapter) returned true as the Safe and then called a caller-supplied router with caller-supplied calldata. The attacker's fake Safe named two real Safes as the router with execTransactionFromModule calldata, so the adapter, as their module, repaid one Safe's 1,330 WETH Aave debt with a Morpho flash loan and withdrew its 1,306 weETH collateral, and transferred out the other's weETH.
notes: The reset is Safe 0xcfedf95a enabling the adapter as a module, the later of the two Safes the anchor drained (0xe3b23e47 enabled it in 0xb43db7a7); the adapter itself was deployed nine days earlier.

Loss is the larger Safe's withdrawn aEthweETH net of the WETH debt the flash loan repaid (a liability, rule 11) plus the weETH taken from the smaller Safe and 0.01 weETH from the larger one by copycat 0xed700b54. Three later copycat calls (refs) moved no victim assets.
